clusters.name: Complementarity / co-production
clusters.claim: A technically or epistemically valid core often needs materials, infrastructure, skill, institutions, demand or operational complements before it can create consequence.

clusters.name: Validation-to-diffusion latency
clusters.claim: Proof, repeatability, manufacturability, institutional adoption and broad diffusion are separable transitions with potentially long gaps.

clusters.name: Instrumentation / observability leverage
clusters.claim: New instruments or disciplined observation protocols can open larger future search spaces than directly optimizing the original task.

clusters.name: Standards / representation as coordination substrate
clusters.claim: A reusable representation, standard or institution can lower future coordination/replication cost even when it does not itself perform the physical task.

clusters.name: Distributed invention and priority compression
clusters.claim: Later hero narratives frequently compress rival routes, predecessors, independent rediscovery and workshop networks into one inventor identity.

clusters.name: Scale-induced boundary shift / externality
clusters.claim: A locally successful intervention can change the surrounding system enough that the relevant objective, risk or harmed party changes at larger scale.

clusters.name: Institutional continuity / effective enactment
clusters.claim: A patent, prize, rule, standard or technical claim gains consequence only through institutions capable of preserving, reproducing, financing or enforcing it.

clusters.name: Local optimality versus general/metaproductive optimality
clusters.claim: The route that is most reusable or advanced in the abstract may lose to a specialized/older route under local demand, infrastructure or cost constraints.

promotionGate: No residual may become an HD historical candidate prior before recurrence across at least three epochs and three materially different domains, then explicit HD9 review.
warning: These clusters were formed after Pass B and therefore are exploratory. Their HD1 recurrence must not be used to rewrite frozen S1-S10/F1-F7.
